summary: Details the process of creating and configuring admission tags, including setting positive or negative labels to trigger follow-up calls or negative remarks. It also provides specific instructions for setting up 'Duplicate' and 'Duplicate Primary' tags for lead management.
steps: Navigate to Admission Setup > Admission Master > Admission Tags.
Enter the desired tag name (e.g., 'Test Tag').
Choose a color combination for the tag.
Select a 'Label': 'Positive' (prompts for follow-up) or 'Negative' (prompts for a negative remark).
Click 'Add New Details', type 'Duplicate' (no leading/trailing spaces).
Choose a random color, mark as 'Negative', and save.
Edit the 'Duplicate' tag, change its Hex value to '000000' (zero out RGB values), and save.
Select any color, add a label (generally 'Positive').
Change its Hex value to '000000' (black), and save.
business_rules: Positive tags require a follow-up to be scheduled.
Negative tags require a negative remark to be entered.
The system automatically marks subsequent leads from the same number as 'Duplicate' and the first lead as 'Duplicate Primary'.
important_notes: The exact spelling 'Duplicate' and 'Duplicate Primary' with no extra spaces is crucial for system functionality.
Setting the Hex value to '000000' (black) is a specific requirement for Duplicate tags.
'Duplicate Primary' helps identify the original lead when multiple leads exist with the same contact information.
